_readme: Play custom store listings and Apple custom product pages, AS DATA. [lane aso-listings]
Nothing here exists in a console. `node tooling/store/custom-listings.mjs --app subscriptiontracker` prints the exact payload
each entry would be created with, and exits non-zero for any entry with `publish: true` unless --publish is passed — which is the
owner's approval at the publish sitting, never an agent's. Creating them in Play Console / App Store Connect is a lead step.
Graded by tooling/ci/assert-store-listings.mjs: limb A (shape), M (the channel's sourced limits) and C (claims) over every field.

listings.audience: Play users in India, where the research found no top listing that leads with 'no bank login' (aso/research-2026-10-03.md §3)

fields.short-description.txt: Every subscription and renewal in one list. No bank login, no card number.

listings.audience: people arriving from a link or Apple Search Ads ad about renewal reminders (aso/research-2026-10-03.md §4)

fields.promotional-text.txt: A reminder before every renewal, and the month's total at a glance. Add each subscription once; no bank login.
